name: Ghost Audit
source:
Nothing in life is sure but death and taxes.  Of course taxes are a thing after death as well.  It is your job to make sure that the ghosts pay those taxes.  You are an auditor from the underworld and it is The Lethe Vista review time.  Of course nothing goes to plan so you’ll have to uncover a little mystery while performing your audit. 

[From [url=https://colorsqueaks.itch.io/ghost-audit]itch.io[/url]]
